The live demo is a local cross-language system: L19: L20: * Browser cockpit served by Python at `/live-compliance/` L21: * Python FastAPI service on `127.0.0.1:8000` L22: * Go A2A compliance service on `:8888` L23: * ADK `RemoteA2aAgent` handoff through the Go Agent Card and A2A JSON-RPC `message/send` L24: The Go service is deterministic by design. It is not an LLM agent; it enforces policy thresholds that need repeatable audit behavior. L25: ## Runtime Flow L26: L27: `flowchart LR L28: UI["Browser Cockpit
/live-compliance/"] L29: API["Python FastAPI
/api/compliance/upload"] L30: EXTRACT["Deterministic Extraction
tools.py"] L31: ADK["ADK RemoteA2aAgent
fast_api_app.py"] L32: CARD["Go Agent Card
/.well-known/agent.json"] L33: RPC["Go JSON-RPC
message/send"] L34: CHECK["Policy Checker
checker.go"] L35: ART["Case + HTML Artifacts
live_compliance.py"] L36: UI -->|"sample text + policy + simulator state"| API L37: API --> EXTRACT L38: EXTRACT --> ADK L39: ADK -->|"GET Agent Card"| CARD L40: ADK -->|"POST JSON-RPC message/send"| RPC L41: RPC --> CHECK L42: CHECK -->|"passed / violations / timestamp"| RPC L43: RPC --> ADK L44: ADK --> API L45: API --> ART L46: ART --> UI L47: ` L48: ## Live Request Path L49: 1. The browser selects a bundled contract fixture from `sample-contracts/`. L50: 2. The browser fetches fixture text from `/api/compliance/sample-contracts/{filename}`. L51: 3. The browser posts the text, active policy values, and simulator settings to `/api/compliance/upload`. L52: 4. Python extracts contract fields with deterministic parsing in `tools.py`. L53: 5. Python classifies risk and builds an A2A data payload. L54: 6. Python creates a focused `RemoteA2aAgent` in `fast_api_app.py`. L55: 7. ADK resolves the Go Agent Card from `GO_AGENT_CARD_URL`. L56: 8. ADK sends A2A JSON-RPC `message/send` to the Go service. L57: 9. Go decodes the data part, applies deterministic policy checks, and returns a completed A2A task. L58: 10. Python stores the case state, generates HTML artifacts, and returns the UI-visible payload. L59: ## A2A Payload Shape L60: Python builds the UI-visible request envelope in `build_go_message_payload(...)`: L61: L62: `{ L63: "jsonrpc": "2.0", L64: "id": "case-{case_id}", L65: "method": "message/send", L66: "params": { L67: "metadata": { L68: "task_id": "{case_id}" L69: }, L70: "message": { L71: "kind": "message", L72: "messageId": "case-{case_id}-request", L73: "taskId": "{case_id}", L74: "role": "user", L75: "parts": [ L76: { L77: "kind": "data", L78: "data": { L79: "schema_version": "contract-compliance.a2a.v1", L80: "case_id": "{case_id}", L81: "contract": { L82: "contract_value": 250000.0, L83: "contractor_name": "ACME CLOUD SOLUTIONS", L84: "insurance_coverage": 2000000.0, L85: "liability_limit": "$1,000,000.00", L86: "term_length_years": 2, L87: "auto_renewal": false, L88: "has_termination_clause": true L89: }, L90: "policy": { L91: "max_contract_value": 500000.0, L92: "required_insurance_minimum": 1000000.0, L93: "max_term_years": 5, L94: "required_termination_clause": true, L95: "prohibited_clauses": ["unlimited liability", "auto-renewal > 3yr"] L96: } L97: } L98: } L99: ] L100: } L101: } L102: }` L103: Go returns a completed A2A task whose status message contains a data part: L104: L105: `{ L106: "passed": false, L107: "violations": [ L108: "Contract value $850000.00 exceeds company framework limit of $500000.00" L109: ], L110: "verdict_timestamp": "2026-06-03T00:00:00Z" L111: }` L112: ## State Outcomes L113: L114: The live cockpit maps Go results into three visible outcomes: L115: L116: Outcome | Trigger L117: --- | --- L118: `APPROVED` | Go returns `passed: true`. L119: `REVIEW_READY` | Go returns `passed: false` with policy violations. L120: `MANUAL_REVIEW` | Go is unavailable or simulator mode is `Crashed (503)`. L121: L122: The richer enum in `state_schema.py` still includes intermediate states used by the fuller ADK reference path, but the cockpit completes the healthy path in one API call. L123: ## Trust Boundaries L124: L125: Browser: L126: L127: * Chooses bundled sample contracts. L128: * Sends policy override values. L129: * Never calls the Go service directly. L130: L131: Python service: L132: L133: * Enforces file extension and 5MB upload limits. L134: * Rejects binary PDF uploads; bundled `.pdf` files are text fixtures. L135: * Resolves sample and artifact paths with basename and root-bound checks. L136: * Calls only the configured Go Agent Card URL. L137: * Fails closed to `MANUAL_REVIEW` when the Go handoff fails. L138: L139: Go service: L140: * Serves an Agent Card at `/.well-known/agent.json`. L141: * Accepts JSON-RPC POST requests. L142: * Handles current `message/send` plus legacy `tasks/send` and `tasks/get`. L143: * Applies deterministic policy rules from `default_policy.json` or request policy overrides. L144: ## Key Files L145: File | Role L146: --- | --- L147: `python-extraction-agent/app/static/live-compliance/index.html` | Browser cockpit. L148: `python-extraction-agent/app/fast_api_app.py` | API routes, ADK handoff, case response. L149: `python-extraction-agent/app/tools.py` | Deterministic extraction and risk classification. L150: `python-extraction-agent/app/live_compliance.py` | Case state, events, artifact generation. L151: `python-extraction-agent/app/agent.py` | Fuller ADK `SequentialAgent` reference. L152: `go-compliance-agent/internal/agentcard/card.go` | Agent Card. L153: `go-compliance-agent/internal/handler/task_handler.go` | A2A JSON-RPC handler. L154: `go-compliance-agent/internal/compliance/checker.go` | Deterministic policy checker. L155: `go-compliance-agent/internal/policies/default_policy.json` | Default policy thresholds.
